rows: Why chiplets instead of one big die?
Large die yield collapses: 4 cm² × 2 = 8 cm² → yield² instead of yield¹
Newer node: better performance but higher wafer cost, lower initial yield
Use mature node (28 nm): mask cost $1-3M vs $25M at 3 nm
Ramp yield fast on mature node; high volume amortizes fixed costs
Bin fastest dies; charge 5-10× for top bin vs slow bin
Minimize area: 10% smaller die → 10% more dies/wafer AND better yield
